release_notes: Build 138 fixes the slowdown that can appear after configuring the Projects Folder by removing recursive legacy project-path recovery from normal Release Readiness and Autopilot refreshes.

Release Readiness now loads quiz history, tracker settings and project-backed readiness files away from the WPF UI thread, so large or network-backed project folders do not block the rest of the app while status is being calculated.
The existing readiness refresh guard remains in place so repeated navigation or refresh requests cannot stack overlapping scans.
Legacy project-path recovery code remains available for explicit repair and diagnostics, while current startup consolidation and database backup/restore protections remain unchanged.
